# 📚 Guides & Resources
-# A curated list of websites, tools and communities to help you get the most out of WoW.

## 🌐 General WoW Resources
[Wowhead](https://www.wowhead.com/wow) - provides players with tools and information to make their gameplay more enjoyable
[Archon.gg](https://www.archon.gg/) - Analyses leaderboards, providing tier lists and class build choices based on popularity and performance
[Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot) - DPS simulator based on "SimulationCraft". used for identifying gear upgrades, comparing talents and reviewing rotations.
[Questionably Epic](https://questionablyepic.com/live/) - HPS simulator, Raidbots for healers.
[WoW Progress](https://www.wowprogress.com/) - A website tracking top raiding characters/guilds
[Raider.io](https://raider.io/) - A website tracking top M+ characters/guilds

## ⚔️ Raid Resources
[Warcraft Logs](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/) - A place to share Raid Combat logs, provides data view and rating.
[WoW Analyzer](https://wowanalyzer.com/) - Provides performance analysis based on combat logs uploaded to Warcraft Logs

## 🗝️ Mythic+ Resources
[Mr Mythical](https://mrmythical.com/) - M+ Score calculator - useful for hunting score/achievements
[Keystone Guru](https://keystone.guru/) - Place for people to share M+ routes
[Murlok.io](https://murlok.io/) - Class builds based on top-rated player data - M+ and PvP
[Not Even Close](https://not-even-close.com/) - Damage calc for M+ keys

## 🎥 Fun/Collection
[Wowpedia](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Wowpedia) - Lore Wiki
[Warcraft Mounts](https://warcraftmounts.com/) - Website focused on mount collecting
[Warcraft Pets](https://www.warcraftpets.com/) - Website focused on pet collecting
[WoW Petopia](https://www.wow-petopia.com/index.php) - Hunter pet Wiki

## 🎥 Content Creators
[Stankie](https://www.youtube.com/@StankieGaming/playlists) - Mythic raid progression and class guides
[HazelNutty](https://www.youtube.com/@Hazelnuttygames/playlists) - Casual and collection content, very community friendly
[ReadyCheckPull](https://www.youtube.com/@ReadyCheckPull/playlists) - Raid strategy and analysis
[Method](https://www.method.gg/) - High end raid content and class guides
[Mythic Trap](https://www.mythictrap.com/en) - Visual raid boss guides and strategies
